programs.notes: CLOSE TO PITTSBURGH (your #1 city!). Fast 11-month program. Standard prereqs. Moderate cost. But weaker NP pathway (unranked MSN). Good if you want to be near Pittsburgh during school, then transfer for NP. Philly has good outdoor access to Appalachians.

program_details.np_pathway_notes: GEM results in MSN + Clinical Nurse Leader (CNL) certification. CNL focus is care coordination/systems leadership, not direct clinical NP path.

programs.notes: Excellent NP pathway with Direct Entry option to doctoral programs. Minimal prereqs make this very accessible. 100% NCLEX pass rate. 24-month program is longer than some ABSNs but yields MSN degree. Strong option for NP career track.

programs.scoring_notes: Strong state school, UC Health system

work_commitment.notes: Up to $7,500/semester for 4 semesters. Must maintain good academic standing.

programs.name: U Kentucky

prerequisites.additional: Minimum C grade in all prereqs. Video interview required.

program_details.format: Hybrid - online didactic + in-person labs/clinicals in Lexington or Ashland

programs.notes: STRONG VALUE option - lower COL, good rankings, standard prereqs. In your 80th percentile sweet spot. Hybrid format gives some flexibility. Lexington is a nice college town but may feel small. Good NP pathway with pioneering DNP program.

programs.name: Baylor

prerequisites.additional: English Comp I & II, English Literature, Federal Government, Bible-based Religion, World Religion, History course. 52 hours total prereqs (33 needed to apply). HESI exam required (80+ English, 80+ Math).

program_details.format: On-campus Dallas (also has Distance ABSN option for TX residents)

programs.notes: Texas option with strong outcomes. HOWEVER: VERY extensive prereqs including Bible-based Religion, World Religion, English Lit, Federal Govt, History. You'd need to complete significant additional coursework. Lower COL is a plus. May 2026 deadline is VERY soon (Jan 15, 2026).

programs.name: DePaul

prerequisites.additional: 2 chemistry courses (organic + inorganic) with labs OR 1 chem + 1 micro with labs. Must have BA/BS with 3.0+ GPA (3.2 preferred).

programs.notes: Lower cost Chicago option. First MENP in Illinois. Offers Balanced Stride option for more flexibility. 75+ clinical sites including guaranteed ICU rotation. Lower prestige but solid outcomes. Good if targeting Chicago area.

programs.name: Edgewood

prerequisites.additional: 2.75 GPA required. Math/science prereqs within 8 years. Grade C minimum. $1,000 deposit on admission.

program_details.format: Full-time in-person (also has online ABSN option)

programs.notes: MADISON BACKUP option. 100% NCLEX pass rate is excellent. Reasonable $45K fixed tuition. Fast 12-month program. BUT: weak NP pathway (BSN only). Close enough to Milwaukee that family pressure might persist. Good value if you just want BSN quickly.

programs.name: Alverno

prerequisites.additional: Prereqs must be within 7 years and grade C or better.

program_details.format: On-campus. Milwaukee or Mesa, AZ locations.

programs.notes: MILWAUKEE BACKUP but has MESA, AZ option! Could use this to get to Arizona instead of staying in Milwaukee. Dual BSN+MSN is efficient - graduate with master's. 18 months is reasonable. Strong local clinical partnerships. Consider Mesa campus if you want Southwest.

programs.name: Regis

prerequisites.additional: Philosophy (3 credits), Religious Studies (6 credits!). Total 56 prereq credits required. Does NOT accept online sciences from Sofia, Straighterline, or Portage.

programs.notes: LOCATION IS GREAT (Denver/mountains) but PREREQS ARE PROBLEMATIC. You'd need Philosophy + 6 credits of Religious Studies on top of everything else. That's a significant hurdle. Also explicitly rejects some online lab providers. 12-month program is fast. Good NP pathway. Weigh location benefits against prereq burden.

programs.name: Samuel Merritt

prerequisites.additional: Pharmacology and Pathophysiology required! TEAS or HESI exam required (80% minimum). BLS certification required.

program_details.format: On-campus. Oakland, Sacramento, or San Mateo campuses.

programs.notes: Bay Area option but PROBLEMATIC PREREQS: Pharmacology + Pathophysiology required BEFORE entry. Most programs teach these IN the program. Very high COL (165 index). Distance from Milwaukee is significant. Probably not worth the prereq hassle.

programs.name: Marquette GEM

prerequisites.additional: Stats must be within 7 years. A&P preferred within 5 years. Need Psych OR Sociology (not both).

program_details.format: Hybrid - Pleasant Prairie (hybrid-online) or Milwaukee (mostly in-person)

programs.notes: Strong local option if you decide staying in Milwaukee is acceptable. Faster than Rush (15 vs 24 months). Pleasant Prairie campus offers hybrid format. Fixed tuition is nice for budgeting. However, you mentioned wanting to LEAVE Milwaukee - factor that into decision.

programs.name: UW-Milwaukee

prerequisites.additional: Prereqs can be in progress when applying but must be complete before start.

program_details.format: Cohort model. Combination of online and on-campus.

programs.notes: LOCAL BACKUP option. VERY affordable in-state ($25K). BUT: keeps you in Milwaukee, which you wanted to leave. 24 months is longer than some. Note: UWM does NOT have traditional 12-month ABSN - only this Direct Entry MN. Good safety school if cost is primary concern.

programs.name: Johns Hopkins

prerequisites.additional: All prereqs must be completed with grade B or higher (not C). JHU offers own online prereq courses at $375/credit.

programs.notes: ELITE program - #1/#2 nationally. However: (1) Your scoring formula PENALIZES elite programs >0.9 percentile, (2) $112K tuition is steep even with scholarship potential, (3) Grade B requirement on prereqs is strict. Worth applying if you want the absolute best NP pathway and can get scholarship money, but may not score well in your system. Deadline for Fall 2026 is Jan 15, 2026 - very soon!

programs.name: UCLA MECN

prerequisites.additional: Chemistry must be combined inorganic/organic/biochem sequence. Epidemiology required. Communication/interpersonal course required. All prereqs grade C+ by Dec 2025.

program_details.format: Full-time, on-campus only. Not available part-time or online.

programs.notes: VERY competitive (7:1 applicant ratio). Extensive prereqs including full chem sequence + epidemiology. HIGH COL (LA). In-state tuition is reasonable but out-of-state is steep. Good rankings but may be penalized by competitiveness formula. Distance from Milwaukee is significant.

programs.name: Columbia

prerequisites.additional: All prereqs must be grade B or higher. Stats must be within 5 years. Labs NOT required. Offers OPEN program for prereqs online.

program_details.np_pathway_notes: Direct Entry MS allows specialty declaration; seamless to DNP

programs.notes: ELITE Ivy program but VERY expensive ($87K) + NYC COL (180 index). Historically top-5 ranked. Labs not required is nice. Grade B requirement on prereqs. Will be penalized by your competitiveness formula. NYC may not match your location preferences (high COL, limited outdoor access).

programs.name: Yale

prerequisites.additional: Only A&P I and A&P II with labs required (4 credits each). Within 8 years. 3.0 GPA on prereqs required. 3.0 cumulative GPA OR top 50th percentile GRE. AP credits NOT accepted.

program_details.format: Full-time, on-campus. 3-year MSN program combining RN prep + specialty.
program_details.np_pathway_notes: GEPN (Graduate Entry Pre-Specialty Nursing) - 3yr program with integrated specialty

programs.notes: MINIMAL prereqs (only A&P!) make this very accessible. BUT: 3-year program is LONG, expensive ($124K), and New Haven may not match your location preferences. Yale prestige but nursing school rankings not elite. Actually falls in your 80th percentile sweet spot. Worth considering if you value minimal prereqs and Ivy brand.

programs.name: North Park

prerequisites.additional: 2.75 GPA required. TEAS exam required (within 1 year of applying).

program_details.format: On-ground with some hybrid elements. Chicago campus.

programs.notes: Another Chicago option. Lower prestige than Rush/DePaul but similar price. TEAS exam required. 20 months is moderate length. Falls in your 80th percentile sweet spot due to not being elite. Could be good backup Chicago option.

scoring_formula.raw_score: (location_score + boost) × prereq_fit^w × online_lab^w × np_pathway^w × prestige^w × competitiveness^w × start_score^w × time_factor^w × cost_score^w
